blind.description: A stylized pile of rough-hewn stone building blocks resting on two parallel wooden skid planks. The blocks feature hand-painted textures with chiseled edges, cracks, and weathered surfaces in varying tones of slate grey, tan, and light brown. Geometry is solid, clean, and well-defined with tight stacking, resting securely on the wooden support beams.
blind.from_above: A compact rectangular pile with two brown wooden beam ends protruding at the front and back, displaying clustered grey and tan stone blocks with one rectangular stone block resting at an angle along the top spine.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: two wooden planks / skid runners underneath
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.3 to 2.5 ft tall) and roughly 2.5 ft wide by 2.5 ft long.
